visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with dark hair, wearing a black beanie and a colorful geometric patterned jacket, sits at a red and black SEGA arcade cabinet. He is focused on the screen, which displays a vibrant 2D character-based card game interface. He manipulates a blue joystick and presses white buttons with his hands while sitting in a modern room with orange and wooden walls. (2) The camera zooms into the arcade screen showing a gold glowing animation as a 'Legendary' card of Liu Bei is drawn. A hand holds up a matching physical collectible card with intricate gold foil and colorful artwork against the screen. The lighting is bright and indoor, highlighting the card's reflective surface and the game's high-contrast visuals. (3) The man stands in a lobby area in front of a white wall featuring a large blue SEGA logo and several colorful posters of characters like Pikachu. He points towards the posters with an excited facial expression and energetic hand gestures. The handheld camera follows his movements as he talks to the viewer in a well-lit indoor environment. (4) Close-up shots show the man's hands rapidly tapping on the arcade buttons and shifting the joystick. The screen displays a dense battlefield where small character units clash with flashy magical effects and numbers indicating damage. Yellow and white text captions frequently overlay the top and bottom of the frame to describe different gameplay mechanics. (5) The scene transitions to a smartphone screen displaying a game app with character galleries and upgrade menus. A finger scrolls through lists of cards and taps on specific icons. The background shifts between the mobile interface, close-ups of physical cards laid out on a surface, and more intense cooperative gameplay footage showing two people at adjacent machines.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced electronic BGM with a driving beat begins immediately. A male voice speaks with high energy and an excited tone, reacting to the visual gameplay. Audible mechanical clicks from arcade buttons being pressed rapidly punctuate the speech. (2) High-pitched digital UI sound effects like pings and sparkles trigger as the game highlights a card. The male narrator's pitch rises in excitement as he calls out 'Legendary!'. (3) The acoustic environment shifts to a slightly more open indoor space, though the BGM and vocal track remain dominant. The speaker's delivery becomes more narrative and informative, explaining the game's features over the consistent electronic melody. (4) Percussive impact SFX from the game's battle scenes (sword slashes, magical blasts) overlap with the narration. Short, rhythmic 'pop' sound effects occur alongside text appearing on screen. (5) Fanfare-like orchestral synth sounds play briefly as 'Victory' is achieved visually. The speaker laughs and cheers, maintaining a high arousal level as the music reaches its peak intensity before a final hard cut.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Feature Overview -> Gameplay Demo -> App Integration -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the launch of SEGA's new card-based arcade machine 'Sangokushi Taisen' (Three Kingdoms Fantasy) in Taiwan by highlighting its physical card collection, gameplay, and mobile app connectivity.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct demonstration of the SEGA arcade machine and gameplay, accompanied by promotional slogans and release dates.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses high-density text overlays and fast-paced editing typical of social media gaming promotions to maintain viewer engagement while explaining complex game systems.
